`shot()` now writes each design screenshot as a 256-color PNG (median cut over the screenshot's distinct colors, weighted by pixel count, no dithering) with `png.BestCompression`. Same 2x size; all 453 screenshots regenerated (adhd-todo task 98).

Projects can hang under another project. The sidebar nests a sub-project under its parent, one 28 pt indent step per level, and a project's context menu gains `New sub-project…`.

- `projects.parent_id` (migration 009, `ON DELETE SET NULL`); `CreateProject` checks the parent exists and is not archiv
